record.context_brief: binomial width bound for tangent-cone Betti numbers
record.original_question: Let Gamma be a numerical semigroup. For every homological degree i, is the i-th Betti number of the associated graded ring G_Gamma always bounded above by binom(width(Gamma)+1, i+1)?

evidence.quote: Problem 15. Let Γ be a numerical semigroup. Is bi(GΓ ) 6 ( width(Γ)+1 i+1 ) for all i?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Gamma \subseteq \mathbb{N}$ be a numerical semigroup, that is, a cofinite submonoid of $(\mathbb{N},+)$ containing $0$. Let $\{n_1 < n_2 < \cdots < n_e\}$ be the minimal system of generators of $\Gamma$, and define the width of $\Gamma$ by
$$\operatorname{width}(\Gamma) = n_e - n_1.$$
Let $k$ be a field, let $k[\Gamma] = k[t^n : n \in \Gamma] \subseteq k[t]$ be the associated semigroup ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak{m} = (t^{n_1},\ldots,t^{n_e})$, and let
$$G_\Gamma = \operatorname{gr}_{\mathfrak{m}}(k[\Gamma]) = \bigoplus_{i\geq 0} \mathfrak{m}^i/\mathfrak{m}^{i+1}$$
be the associated graded ring (the tangent cone of $k[\Gamma]$ at the origin). For each integer $i \ge 0$, let $b_i(G_\Gamma) = \dim_k \operatorname{Tor}_i^{S}(G_\Gamma, k)$ denote the $i$-th Betti number of $G_\Gamma$ over the polynomial ring $S = k[x_1,\ldots,x_e]$ presenting it.

Prove or disprove: for every numerical semigroup $\Gamma$ and every $i \ge 0$,
$$b_i(G_\Gamma) \;\le\; \binom{\operatorname{width}(\Gamma)+1}{\,i+1\,}.$$
artifact.category_tag: Numerical semigroup rings and tangent cones
artifact.status_search_result: Search results indicate that Betti numbers of the tangent cone of a numerical semigroup ring are known to be bounded by a function of the width (results of Vu, Herzog and coauthors), but no source found establishes the specific binomial bound $\binom{\operatorname{width}(\Gamma)+1}{i+1}$ for all $i$. The problem appears to be an explicit conjectural sharpening that is still open.

status_evidence.title: Betti numbers for numerical semigroup rings
status_evidence.snippet: If the width of a semigroup is bounded, then the Betti numbers of K[H] are bounded; extended to the tangent cone grm K[H].
status_evidence.claim: Boundedness of Betti numbers of the tangent cone in terms of width is established, but the explicit binomial bound is not shown.

status_evidence.title: On the defining equations of the tangent cone of a numerical semigroup ring
status_evidence.snippet: The number of defining equations of the tangent cone of a numerical semigroup ring is bounded by a value depending only on the width.
status_evidence.claim: Only the case i=1 (defining equations) is addressed with width-dependent bounds in the literature found.
